trigger: A metric-required field still has no exact two-of-three majority after the independent blind field-only re-review.
selection: Select anonymous item IDs and unresolved field names without joining the method/source audit.

adjudicator.type: a fresh isolated Codex judge session that did not participate in round one or re-review
adjudicator.inputs: Same frozen gold, anonymous task, node name, highlighted preview, and within-asset anonymous node list.
adjudicator.output: One final value only for each unresolved field plus a concise reason.

replacement: The blind adjudicator value resolves only the still-unresolved field. It cannot change any first-round or re-review consensus field.
failure_policy: If the adjudicator leaves an invalid or missing value, the dependent metric remains null.
required_disclosure: Report the adjudicated item and asset counts, fraction of the full task set, field names, adjudicator type, and the fact that it is a single blind tie-break rather than a fourth vote over every task.
